title: Land-use claim verification gate
description: Deduplicate the claim set behind a land-use finding, verify each claim independently against imagery, record, and ground truth, and block publication while any is unverified.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-geo-01
  title: Land-use claim verification gate
  description: Deduplicate the claim set behind a land-use finding, verify each claim independently against
    imagery, record, and ground truth, and block publication while any is unverified.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Publish a land-use analysis in which every stated change is verified against independent
    evidence and unverified claims are listed rather than smoothed away.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Draft findings and evidence layers
      summary: Draft findings and evidence layers
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - draft_findings
              - imagery_series
              - parcel_records
              - validation_sample
            properties:
              draft_findings: {}
              imagery_series: {}
              parcel_records: {}
              validation_sample: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-dedupe
      kind: transform
      name: Deduplicate claim set
      summary: deduplicate draft_findings by normalized location and change type
      config:
        operation: deduplicate
        expression: deduplicate draft_findings by normalized location and change type
    - id: n-verify1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: geo-01
      name: Verify against imagery and change detection
      summary: 'Verification pass 1: verify against imagery and change detection.'
      role: Analyst deriving land-surface information from imagery with stated method and error.
      prompt: You are a Remote Sensing Analyst. You derive land-surface products from imagery with the
        sensor, acquisition date, atmospheric correction, and classification method stated, and you report
        accuracy from an independent validation sample rather than from training performance. You separate
        a real land-surface change from a difference in sensor, season, or illumination, because most
        detected change in a naive comparison is not change.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - geospatial-analysis
          - teaching
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:earth-observation
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: geo-03
      name: Verify against parcel and policy records
      summary: 'Verification pass 2: verify against parcel and policy records.'
      role: Analyst assessing land use, zoning, and development patterns spatially.
      prompt: You are a Land Use & Urban Analyst. You analyze development patterns, accessibility, and
        land-use change against policy boundaries and the actual parcel record, and you state which conclusions
        depend on the aggregation unit you chose. You test whether a spatial pattern survives a different
        aggregation, because zone-level conclusions that flip when the boundary moves are artifacts, not
        findings.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - accessibility
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:gis
          - mcp:parcel-data
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: geo-05
      name: Verify against the independent validation sample
      summary: 'Verification pass 3: verify against the independent validation sample.'
      role: Analyst designing and executing validation of geospatial products.
      prompt: You are a Ground Truth & Validation Analyst. You design validation samples that are independent,
        spatially representative, and adequately sized, and you report the confusion matrix and its uncertainty
        rather than a single accuracy figure. You reject validation that reuses training locations, because
        it measures memorization and reports it as accuracy.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - design-review
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:earth-observation
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect verification results
      summary: Source-tag every verification result so an unverified item stays attributable.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-unresolved
      kind: condition
      name: Any unverified items?
      summary: Route on collected.unverified is empty.
      config:
        expression: collected.unverified is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clear
            when: clear
          - label: Unverified remain
            when: unverified
    - id: n-resolve
      kind: agent
      templateRef: geo-04
      name: Rewrite or withdraw unverified findings
      summary: Close, replace, or explicitly withdraw each unverified item.
      role: Cartographer designing maps that are accurate, legible, and honest.
      prompt: You are a Cartographic Communicator. You choose projection, classification, and symbology
        for the question the map answers, and you state the class breaks and normalization so the reader
        can see how the pattern was made. You avoid choices that manufacture a pattern — misleading class
        breaks, unnormalized counts, projections that exaggerate the area under discussion — even when
        the resulting map is less striking.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - privacy-review
          - scientific-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - accessibility
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:gis
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Programme lead approves publication of the analysis
      summary: Pause for the programme lead; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Land-use claim verification gate deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-dedupe
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-2
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-3
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-4
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-5
      from: n-verify1
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-6
      from: n-verify2
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-7
      from: n-verify3
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-8
      from: n-collect
      to: n-unresolved
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-9
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clear
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-10
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-resolve
      kind: control
      condition: unverified
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-11
      from: n-resolve
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-geo-01-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
